theorem algebra_277724 (x : ℝ) : 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3 ↔ x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
  constructor
  · -- Assume 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3, prove x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
    intro h_eq
    let n := ⌊x⌋
    have hn1 : n ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact Int.floor_le x
    have hn2 : x < (n + 1 : ℝ) := by exact Int.lt_floor_add_one x
    have h_eq2 : 3 * x ^ 3 - (n : ℝ) = 3 := by
      simpa using h_eq
    have h_eq3 : 3 * x ^ 3 = 3 + (n : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    have h_eq4 : x ^ 3 = 1 + (n : ℝ) / 3 := by
      nlinarith
    have h1 : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have h2 : n ≥ 2 := by omega
      have h3 : (n : ℝ) ≥ (2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 - (2 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (2 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (1 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (4 / 3 : ℝ)), h_eq3, hn1, hn2, h3]
    have h2 : n ≥ 1 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have h3 : n ≤ 0 := by omega
      have h4 : (n : ℝ) ≤ (0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h3
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 2 - (1 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (1 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (0 : ℝ)), sq_nonneg (x - (4 / 3 : ℝ)), h_eq3, hn1, hn2, h4]
    have hn : n = 1 := by omega
    have h5 : (n : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hx3 : x ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [h_eq3, h5]
    have hx : x = (4 / 3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
      have h1 : x ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := hx3
      have h2 : x = (x ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul]
        norm_num
        all_goals linarith
      rw [h2, h1]
      all_goals norm_num
    exact hx
  · -- Assume x = (4 / 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3), prove 3 * x ^ 3 - ⌊x⌋ = 3
    intro h_eq
    have hx3 : x ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h_eq]
      have h1 : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ 3 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul]
        norm_num
        all_goals norm_num
      linarith
    have hn1 : ⌊x⌋ = 1 := by
      have h1 : 1 < x := by
        rw [h_eq]
        have h : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) > (1 : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (1 : ℝ) := by
            simp
          have h3 : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) > (1 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow
            · norm_num
            · linarith
            · norm_num
          linarith [h2, h3]
        linarith
      have h2 : x < (2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [h_eq]
        have h : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) < (2 : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : (4 / 3 : ℝ) < (8 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          have h2 : (8 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (2 : ℝ) := by
            have h1 : (8 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = (2 : ℝ) := by
              rw [show (8 : ℝ) = 2 ^ (3 : ℝ) by norm_num]
              simp [Real.rpow_mul]
            linarith
          have h3 : ((4 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) < (8 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow
            · linarith
            · linarith
            · norm_num
          linarith [h2, h3]
        linarith
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor <;> (try norm_num) <;> nlinarith
    have h_eq2 : (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
    have h_eq3 : 3 * x ^ 3 = 4 := by
      nlinarith [hx3]
    linarith [h_eq3, h_eq2]

theorem algebra_18 {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} :
    ∃ Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      P = Q - R ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,

theorem algebra_18 {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} :
    ∃ Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      P = Q - R ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 := by 
  use P ^ 2 + 1 
  use P ^ 2 + 1 - P 
  constructor
  · -- Show P = Q - R 
    ring_nf 
  · -- Show ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 
    intro x 
    have h1 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1) ≥ 0 := by
      have eq1 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1) = (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) := by 
        simp [pow_two, MvPolynomial.eval_add, MvPolynomial.eval_pow]
      rw [eq1] 
      have h3 : (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by 
        apply sq_nonneg 
      linarith 
    have h2 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1 - P) ≥ 0 := by 
      have eq2 : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1 - P) = (MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1)) - (MvPolynomial.eval x P) := by 
        simp [MvPolynomial.eval_sub] 
      rw [eq2] 
      have eq1' : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1) = (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) := by 
        simp [pow_two, MvPolynomial.eval_add, MvPolynomial.eval_pow]
      rw [eq1']
      have h4 : (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + (1 : ℝ) - (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ≥ 0 := by 
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((MvPolynomial.eval x P) - (1 / 2 : ℝ))]
      linarith 
    constructor 
    · -- Show MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 
      linarith [h1]

theorem algebra_11896 {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha1 : a 1 = 1 / 2)
    (han : ∀ n ≥ 1, a n = 2 * a n * a (n + 1) + 3 * a (n + 1)) :
    ∀ n ≥ 1, a n = 1 / (3 ^ n - 1) := by
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero => linarith -- base case n = 0, impossible as n ≥ 1
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      rw [ha1]
      norm_num
      <;> field_simp
      <;> norm_num
    | succ n =>
      have ih' := ih (by linarith)
      have h8 := han (n + 1) (by linarith)
      have h9 : a (n + 2) = a (n + 1) / (2 * a (n + 1) + 3) := by
        -- Rewrite from `h8` to get expression from term `n` to term `n+1`
        -- invert solve from `a (n+1) = 2 * a (n+1) * a (n+2) + 3 * a (n+2)`
        -- to `a (n+2) = a (n+1) / (2 * a (n+1) + 3)`
        have h10 : 2 * a (n + 1) + 3 ≠ 0 := by
          by_contra h
          have h11 : a (n + 1) = -3 / 2 := by linarith
          rw [h11] at h8
          norm_num at h8
          all_goals nlinarith [ih']
        have h12 : (2 * a (n + 1) + 3) ≠ 0 := h10
        field_simp [h12]
        nlinarith
      rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega]
      rw [h9]
      rw [ih']
      have h_pos : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
      have h_nonzero : (3 ^ (n + 1) - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        have h1 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 1 := by
          have h2 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≥ (3 : ℝ) ^ 1 := by
            apply pow_le_pow_right
            all_goals nlinarith
          have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ^ 1 = 3 := by norm_num
          have h4 : (3 : ℝ) > 1 := by norm_num
          nlinarith [h2, h3]
        nlinarith
      field_simp
      ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [show (3 ^ (n : ℕ) : ℝ) > 0 by positivity]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
      <;> try { 
        have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      }
      <;> try { 
        have h_zero : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) > 0 := by positivity
        have h_zero' : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n) > 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
      }
      <;> try {

        have h_zero' : (3 : ℝ) ^ (n) > 0 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      }

      <;> try {

      <;> try {

      <;> try {

        try {

$\textbf{(A) } 12\quad \textbf{(B) } 10\quad \textbf{(C) } 5\quad \textbf{(D) } 3\quad \textbf{(E) 2}$ -/
theorem algebra_96267 {a r : ℝ} (hr : |r| < 1)
(hsum : ∑' n : ℕ, a * r ^ n = 15) (hsumsq : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = 45) :

theorem algebra_96267 {a r : ℝ} (hr : |r| < 1)
(hsum : ∑' n : ℕ, a * r ^ n = 15) (hsumsq : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = 45) :
a = 5 := by
  have h1 : ∑' n : ℕ, a * r ^ n = a / (1 - r) := by
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one]
    · ring
    · -- Show that |r| < 1
      simpa using hr
  have h2 : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = a^2 / (1 - r^2) := by
    have h : ∑' n : ℕ, (a * r ^ n) ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℕ, a^2 * (r^2) ^ n := by
      congr
      funext n
      ring_nf
    rw [h]
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one]
    · ring
    · -- Show that |r^2| < 1
      have h3 : |r ^ 2| < 1 := by
        have h4 : r^2 < 1 := by
          nlinarith [abs_lt.mp hr, sq_nonneg r]
        have h5 : -1 < r^2 := by
          nlinarith [abs_lt.mp hr, sq_nonneg r]
        apply abs_lt.mpr
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      simpa using h3
  rw [h1] at hsum
  rw [h2] at hsumsq
  have h3 : r ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    -- Now r = 1
    have h4 : |r| = 1 := by
      rw [h]
      norm_num [abs]
    have h5 : |r| < (1 : ℝ) := hr

      have h3 : 0 < (b + c + a) := by positivity

theorem algebra_280203 (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a ∧ a < 1) :
    ((Real.sqrt (1 + a)) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) +
     (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a)) *
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) - 1 / a) = -1 := by

  have ha1 : 0 < a := ha.1
  have ha2 : a < 1 := ha.2
  have ha3 : 0 < 1 - a := by linarith
  have ha4 : 0 < 1 + a := by linarith
  have ha5 : 0 < 1 - a^2 := by nlinarith

  have h1 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) = Real.sqrt (1 - a) * Real.sqrt (1 + a) := by
    have h2 : (1 - a^2 : ℝ) = (1 - a) * (1 + a) := by
      nlinarith
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (1 - a : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h4 : 0 ≤ (1 + a : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by nlinarith)]

  have h2 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) = (1 + a + Real.sqrt (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (1 - a)) / (2 * a) := by
    have h3 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a) ≠ 0 := by
      have h4 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) > Real.sqrt (1 - a) := by
        apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt
        all_goals nlinarith
      nlinarith
    field_simp [h3]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + a), Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 + a by linarith), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - a by linarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3]
  
  have h3 : (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a) = (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) + 1 - a) / (2 * a) := by
    have h4 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a ≠ 0 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 - a ^ 2 : ℝ) by nlinarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3, sq_pos_of_pos ha4]
    field_simp [h4]
    have h5 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) ^ 2 = 1 - a^2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - a^2 by nlinarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3, sq_pos_of_pos ha4]
  
  have h4 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a) - Real.sqrt (1 - a)) + (1 - a) / (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1 + a) = (1 + Real.sqrt (1 - a^2)) / a := by
    rw [h2, h3]
    have h5 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (1 - a) = Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) := by
      have h12 : Real.sqrt (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (1 - a) = Real.sqrt ((1 + a) * (1 - a)) := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by nlinarith)]
      have h13 : (1 + a) * (1 - a) = 1 - a^2 := by
        nlinarith
      rw [h13] at h12
      linarith [h12]
    rw [h5] at h2
    field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith, show 1 - a ≠ 0 by linarith]
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (1 - a^2 : ℝ) by nlinarith)]
  
  have h5 : Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) = Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) / a := by
    have h6 : (1 / a^2) - 1 = (1 - a^2) / a^2 := by
      field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith]
      <;> nlinarith
    rw [h6]
    have h7 : Real.sqrt ((1 - a^2) / a^2) = Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) / Real.sqrt (a^2) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_div (by nlinarith)]
    rw [h7]
    have h8 : Real.sqrt (a^2) = a := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (show 0 ≤ a by linarith)]
    rw [h8]

  have h6 : Real.sqrt ((1 / a^2) - 1) - 1 / a = (Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) - 1) / a := by
    rw [h5]
    field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith]
    all_goals linarith

  rw [h4, h6]

  have h7 : Real.sqrt (1 - a^2) ^ 2 = 1 - a^2 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    nlinarith

  field_simp [show a ≠ 0 by linarith, h7]
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a^2), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1 - a^2 by nlinarith), sq_pos_of_pos ha1, sq_pos_of_pos ha3]

theorem algebra_11391 {a b c : ℝ} (ha : a = Real.logb 8 5) (hb : b = Real.logb 4 3) (hc : c = 2 / 3) :
    b > a ∧ a > c := by
  have ha' : a = Real.log 5 / Real.log 8 := by

    field_simp [Real.logb]

    rw [show (8 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 3 by norm_num]
    simp [Real.log_pow]
    all_goals linarith
  
  have h2 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 by norm_num]
    simp [Real.log_pow]
    all_goals linarith

    rw [h1]
  
  have hb'' : b = Real.log 3 / (2 * Real.log 2) := by
    rw [hb']
    rw [h2]

    apply Real.log_pos
    all_goals linarith

    have h4 : 3 * Real.log 3 > 2 * Real.log 5 := by

      have h6 : 2 * Real.log 5 = Real.log (5 ^ 2 : ℝ) := by

            (3 * Real.log 3 - 2 * Real.log 5) / (6 * Real.log 2) := by

    have h3 : Real.log 2 > 0 := h3

          <;> ring
        rw [h9]

theorem algebra_201515 {x y z : ℝ} (h₀ : x ≠ 0) (h₁ : y ≠ 0) (h₂ : z ≠ 0)
    (h₃ : 1/x + 2/y + 3/z = 0) (h₄ : 1/x - 6/y - 5/z = 0) :
    x/y + y/z + z/x = -1 := by 
  have eq1 : y * z + 2 * x * z + 3 * x * y = 0 := by
    have h3' : 1 / x + 2 / y + 3 / z = 0 := h₃
    field_simp [h₀, h₁, h₂] at h3' ⊢
    linarith
  have eq2 : y * z - 6 * x * z - 5 * x * y = 0 := by
    have h4' : 1 / x - 6 / y - 5 / z = 0 := h₄
    field_simp [h₀, h₁, h₂] at h4' ⊢
    linarith
  have eq3 : x * (y + z) = 0 := by 
    nlinarith [eq1, eq2]
  have eq4 : y + z = 0 := by
    apply (mul_left_inj' h₀).mp
    linarith
  have h5 : z = -y := by linarith
  rw [h5] at eq2
  have eq5 : y * (y - x) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [eq2]
  cases' (mul_eq_zero.mp eq5) with hy1 hy2
  · -- y = 0 is a contradiction
    exfalso
    apply h₁
    linarith
  · -- y - x = 0
    have eq6 : y = x := by linarith
    have eq7 : z = -x := by
      linarith [eq6, h5]
    have eq8 : x / y = 1 := by
      rw [show y = x by linarith [eq6]]
      field_simp [h₀]
    have eq9 : y / z = -1 := by
      rw [show z = -x by linarith [eq7]]
      rw [show y = x by linarith [eq6]]
      field_simp [h₀]
    have eq10 : z / x = -1 := by 
      rw [show z = -x by linarith [eq7]]
      field_simp [h₀]
    rw [eq8, eq9, eq10]
    all_goals norm_num

x^{2}+\frac{8}{x y}+y^{2} \geq 8
$$
for all positive real numbers $x$ and $y$. -/

theorem inequalities_213843 (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    x^2 + 8 / (x * y) + y^2 ≥ 8 := by
  have h1 : 0 < x * y := mul_pos hx hy
  have h2 : x^2 + 8 / (x * y) + y^2 - 8 ≥ 0 := by
    have h3 : x^2 + 8 / (x * y) + y^2 - 8 = (x^2 * (x * y) + 8 + y^2 * (x * y) - 8 * (x * y)) / (x * y) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h3]
    have h4 : x^2 * (x * y) + 8 + y^2 * (x * y) - 8 * (x * y) ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (x * y - 2), sq_nonneg (x * y), sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (y - 2),
        mul_pos hx hy, mul_pos hx (show 0 < y by linarith), mul_pos (show 0 < x by linarith) hy]
    have h5 : (x * y) > 0 := by
      positivity
    have h6 : (x^2 * (x * y) + 8 + y^2 * (x * y) - 8 * (x * y)) / (x * y) ≥ 0 := by
      apply div_nonneg
      linarith
      positivity
    linarith
  linarith

theorem algebra_161293 : (Real.sqrt (21 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5) / (4 + Real.sqrt 5)) * (Real.sqrt (9 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5)) = Real.sqrt 5 - 2 := by
results.formal_proof:

theorem algebra_161293 : (Real.sqrt (21 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5) / (4 + Real.sqrt 5)) * (Real.sqrt (9 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5)) = Real.sqrt 5 - 2 := by
  have h1 : Real.sqrt (21 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5) = 4 + Real.sqrt 5 := by
    have h2 : (4 + Real.sqrt 5) ^ 2 = 21 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5 := by
      calc
        (4 + Real.sqrt 5) ^ 2 = 4 ^ 2 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5 + Real.sqrt 5 ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 16 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5 + (Real.sqrt 5 ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = 16 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5 + 5 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 5 by norm_num)]
        _ = 21 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5 := by ring
    have h3 : 4 + Real.sqrt 5 ≥ 0 := by
      positivity
    rw [←h2]
    field_simp [Real.sqrt_sq h3]
  have h3 : Real.sqrt (21 + 8 * Real.sqrt 5) / (4 + Real.sqrt 5) = 1 := by
    rw [h1]
    field_simp [show 4 + Real.sqrt 5 ≠ 0 by positivity]
    <;> nlinarith
    <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
  have h4 : Real.sqrt (9 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5) = Real.sqrt 5 - 2 := by
    have h5 : (Real.sqrt 5 - 2) ^ 2 = 9 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5 := by
      calc
        (Real.sqrt 5 - 2) ^ 2 = Real.sqrt 5 ^ 2 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5 + 4 := by ring
        _ = 5 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5 + 4 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 5 by norm_num)]
        _ = 9 - 4 * Real.sqrt 5 := by ring
    have h6 : Real.sqrt 5 - 2 ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 5 by norm_num)]
    rw [←h5]
    field_simp [Real.sqrt_sq h6]
  rw [h3, h4]
  <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
  <;> nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 5, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 5 by norm_num)]

    (hl3 : l3 = fun x y => 4 * x - 6 * y = 5) :

    (hl1 : l1 = fun x y => 3 * y - 2 * x = 1)
    (hl2 : l2 = fun x y => x + 2 * y = 2)
    (hl3 : l3 = fun x y => 4 * x - 6 * y = 5) :
    {p : ℝ × ℝ | l1 p.1 p.2 ∧ l2 p.1 p.2 ∨ l1 p.1 p.2 ∧ l3 p.1 p.2 ∨
      l2 p.1 p.2 ∧ l3 p.1 p.2}.ncard = 2 := by
  have h1 : {p : ℝ × ℝ | l1 p.1 p.2 ∧ l2 p.1 p.2 ∨ l1 p.1 p.2 ∧ l3 p.1 p.2 ∨
      l2 p.1 p.2 ∧ l3 p.1 p.2} = {(4 / 7, 5 / 7), (11 / 7, 3 / 14)} := by
    ext ⟨x, y⟩
    simp [hl1, hl2, hl3]
    constructor
    · -- Assume (x, y) is on two lines, show it's one of the two points
      rintro (h | h | h)
      · -- Case where (x, y) is on both l1 and l2
        have h1 : 3 * y - 2 * x = 1 := h.1
        have h2 : x + 2 * y = 2 := h.2
        have hx : x = 4 / 7 := by
          linarith
        have hy : y = 5 / 7 := by
          linarith [h1, h2]
        left
        simp [hx, hy]
      · -- Case where (x, y) is on both l1 and l3
        have h1 : 3 * y - 2 * x = 1 := h.1
        have h3 : 4 * x - 6 * y = 5 := h.2

        linarith

        have h2 : x + 2 * y = 2 := h.1
        have h3 : 4 * x - 6 * y = 5 := h.2
        have hx : x = 11 / 7 := by

        have hy : y = 3 / 14 := by
          linarith [h2, h3]

        right

          norm_num
        · -- On l3: 4 * (11/7) - 6 * (3/14) = 5
          norm_num
  rw [h1]
  rw [Set.ncard_pair]
  all_goals norm_num
  <;> norm_num
  all_goals linarith

  all_goals linarith

theorem calculus_22162 {a c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h : !![a, 0; c, d] * !![a, c; 0, d] = !![4, -6; -6, 34]) :

  have he11 : a^2 = 4 := by 
    have eq11 := congr_arg (λ m => m 0 0) h
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply] at eq11

  have he12 : a * c = -6 := by

  have he21 : a * c = -6 := by

  have he22 : c^2 + d^2 = 34 := by

    simp [Matrix.mul_apply] at eq22 
    nlinarith
  have ha2 : a = 2 := by

  have hc3 : c = -3 := by

    nlinarith
  have hd5 : d = 5 := by

/- Find the two-digit number that is equal to twice the product of its digits. Express the number in the form $10x + y$, where $x$ and $y$ are the digits of the number. -/
theorem algebra_105 {n : ℕ} (hdigit : (Nat.digits 10 n).length = 2)
    (heq : n = 2 * (Nat.digits 10 n).prod) :
    n = 36 := by
results.formal_proof:
import Mathlib

theorem algebra_105 {n : ℕ} (hdigit : (Nat.digits 10 n).length = 2)
    (heq : n = 2 * (Nat.digits 10 n).prod) :
    n = 36 := by
  have h1 : n ≥ 10 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    interval_cases n <;> norm_num at hdigit <;> all_goals contradiction

  have h2 : n ≤ 99 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have h3 : (Nat.digits 10 n).length > 2 := by
      have h4 : n ≥ 100 := by omega
      have h5 : (Nat.digits 10 n).length > 2 := by
        have h6 : (Nat.digits 10 n).length ≥ 3 := by 
          have h7 : n ≥ 100 := by linarith
          have h8 : (Nat.digits 10 n).length ≥ 3 := by
            have h9 : (Nat.digits 10 n).length = Nat.log 10 n + 1 := by 
              rw [Nat.digits_len]
              all_goals linarith
            have h10 : Nat.log 10 n ≥ 2 := by 
              have h11 : 10 ^ 2 ≤ n := by omega
              have h12 : Nat.log 10 n ≥ 2 := by
                exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) h11
              linarith
            omega
          linarith
        linarith
      linarith
    linarith [hdigit, h3]

  interval_cases n <;> norm_num at heq hdigit <;> all_goals trivial

theorem inequalities_596863 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    a^2 / b + b^2 / a ≥ a + b := by
  have h1 : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
  have h2 : a^2 / b + b^2 / a - (a + b) ≥ 0 := by
    have h3 : a^2 / b + b^2 / a - (a + b) = (a^3 + b^3 - (a^2 * b + a * b^2)) / (a * b) := by

      ring
    rw [h3]

      ring
    have h5 : (a - b) ^ 2 * (a + b) ≥ 0 := by
      have h6 : (a - b) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
        apply sq_nonneg
      have h7 : a + b > 0 := add_pos ha hb
      nlinarith
    have h8 : (a^3 + b^3 - (a^2 * b + a * b^2)) ≥ 0 := by
      linarith [h4, h5]
    apply div_nonneg
    linarith
    all_goals nlinarith

theorem number_theory_2837 {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
(h : 3 * p + 7 * q = 41) : (p + 1) * (q - 1) = 12 := by
  have h1 : p ≤ 13 := by linarith [h]
  have h2 : q ≤ 5 := by linarith [h]
  have h3 : q ≥ 2 := by
    by_contra h3
    push_neg at h3
    have h4 : q < 2 := by linarith
    interval_cases q <;> norm_num at hq <;> try { contradiction }
    all_goals omega

  have h4 : q = 2 ∨ q = 3 ∨ q = 5 := by
    interval_cases q <;> norm_num at hq <;> try { tauto }
  
  rcases h4 with hq2 | hq3 | hq5
  · -- Case q = 2
    have hq2' : q = 2 := by omega
    have hp9 : 3 * p = 27 := by
      rw [hq2'] at h
      omega
    have hp9' : p = 9 := by
      linarith [hp9]
    rw [hp9'] at hp
    norm_num at hp
    all_goals try contradiction
  · -- Case q = 3
    have hq3' : q = 3 := by omega
    have h1' : 3 * p = 20 := by 
      rw [hq3'] at h
      omega
    omega
  · -- Case q = 5
    have hq5' : q = 5 := by omega
    have eq1 : 3 * p = 6 := by
      rw [hq5'] at h
      omega
    have hp2 : p = 2 := by 
      omega
    calc 
      (p + 1) * (q - 1) = (2 + 1) * (5 - 1) := by rw [hp2, hq5']
      _ = 12 := by norm_num

    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hz : 0 < z)
    (hxyz : x * y * z = 1) :

theorem inequalities_140071
    (x y z : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 < x)
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hz : 0 < z)
    (hxyz : x * y * z = 1) :
    3 / 4 ≤ x ^ 3 / ((1 + y) * (1 + z)) + y ^ 3 / ((1 + z) * (1 + x)) +
    z ^ 3 / ((1 + x) * (1 + y)) := by
  have h1 : 0 < (1 + x) * (1 + y) * (1 + z) := by
    apply mul_pos
    apply mul_pos
    all_goals nlinarith
  
  have h2 : x ^ 3 / ((1 + y) * (1 + z)) + y ^ 3 / ((1 + z) * (1 + x)) +
    z ^ 3 / ((1 + x) * (1 + y)) = (x^3 * (1 + x) + y^3 * (1 + y) + z^3 * (1 + z)) / ((1 + x) * (1 + y) * (1 + z)) := by
    field_simp
    <;> ring
    <;> nlinarith
    all_goals ring_nf <;> field_simp <;> nlinarith

      sq_nonneg (x - 1), sq_nonneg (y - 1), sq_nonneg (z - 1),
